messages:
alex_support: Heads-up — escalating Civica Labs onboarding. Their embedding ingest keeps hitting 403s after a key rotation; blocked from mapping >50 users. Renewal touch in ~26 days, marking as at-risk. Support ticket #12345 with customer screenshots and request IDs.

priya_cs: Thanks Alex. Adding to CS queue and will own comms. Can someone from infra confirm root cause and ETA? Need a mitigation path before Tom schedules the customer call.

tom_csm: I'll take the customer call. Propose tomorrow 10:00am PT — please confirm ETA so I can set expectations. Also want a concise workaround we can share on the call.

raj_infra: Looking at logs now — requests from the customer's private connector are getting 403 because the service-account token wasn't propagated after the last key rotation. Working on a hotfix to refresh connector tokens and re-sync vault entries. ETA ~45m.

alex_support: Workaround we used for a single customer: create a temporary API key via Console > Keys > Create, scope to embeds only, share via secure support channel. That let them reprocess ~200 users. Shared key in ticket privately.

priya_cs: Comms plan (proposed):
- Immediate: notify customer we've identified cause and provided temporary key workaround (done).
- Short term (today): hotfix from infra to restore normal auth flows and monitor.
- Follow-up (RCA): written RCA + expected remediation timeline + offer of one-time renewal goodwill (30 days free) if onboarding delay impacted go-live.
Tom, please draft the call agenda + follow-up email; I'll review.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: hotfix rollout started to infra-cluster-3 (canary).

raj_infra: Hotfix applied to canary and promoted to cluster-3 prod. Monitoring shows ingest requests returning 200 now. Command used to tail logs: ```kubectl logs -n prod svc-ingest -f | grep '403'``` — counts dropping to zero.

alex_support: Customer reports embed ingest resumed and they reprocessed ~200 users successfully. They want a formal RCA and assurance that keys/rotations won't break pipelines. Renewal still flagged as at-risk — they're uneasy.

priya_cs: I'll prepare the RCA and proposed SLA credit. Action items:
- Raj: confirm fix persisted and what prevented auto-propagation (assign follow-up).
- Alex: update ticket with timeline + shared workaround details and customer confirmation.
- Tom: send calendar invite for the 10:00am PT sync and draft the follow-up email.

tom_csm: Draft email will be posted here before 09:00am PT tomorrow. I'll include the high-level RCA, workaround steps, and next steps for preventing recurrence. If the customer asks for exec-level engagement, loop in leadership.

priya_cs: I'll add the thread summary to the customer record: 'Civica Labs — onboarding ingest outage (403) after key rotation; mitigated; RCA in progress; renewal flagged as at-risk; follow-up call scheduled.' Closing escalation once RCA + customer acknowledgement complete.

alex_support: Thanks team — appreciate the quick turnaround. Will ping if the customer requests escalation to Sales/Legal.
